newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Rieter sees at least steady 1996 profits.
newsitem.headline: Rieter sees at least steady 1996 profits.

text.p: Textile machinery and auto parts maker Rieter Holding AG said it expected its 1996 group net profit to at least match 1995's 52.6 million Swiss francs.
"The net profit of the Rieter Group will at least reach the previous year," Rieter said in a statement that also showed that 1996 sales rose 10 percent to 2.211 billion francs.
Rieter's profit forecast is more optimistic than its forecast from August, when it said net profit for 1996 was likely to be slightly lower than in 1995 due to restructuring costs.
